title: Fair Housing Statement
content:
## Our Commitment to Fair Housing

Mallan Real Estate Inc. is committed to upholding the principles of fair housing for all. We support the Fair Housing Act, the New York State Human Rights Law, and the New York City Human Rights Law.

## Equal Opportunity

We provide equal professional service without regard to:

### Federal Fair Housing Act Protected Classes

- Race or color
- Religion
- National origin
- Sex
- Familial status
- Disability

### New York State Human Rights Law Additional Protections

- Sexual orientation
- Gender identity or expression
- Marital status
- Age
- Military status
- Lawful source of income
- Domestic violence victim status

### New York City Human Rights Law Additional Protections

- Citizenship status
- Partnership status
- Caregiver status
- Immigration status
- Arrest or conviction record
- Status as a victim of domestic violence, stalking, or sex offenses
- Lawful occupation
- Any other protected class under applicable law

## Our Pledge

All real estate advertised on this website is subject to the Federal Fair Housing Act, the New York State Human Rights Law, and the New York City Human Rights Law, which make it illegal to advertise any preference, limitation, or discrimination based on protected characteristics.

We will not knowingly accept any advertising for real estate which violates the law. All persons are hereby informed that all dwellings advertised are available on an equal opportunity basis.

## Advertising Compliance

All property descriptions and marketing materials used by Mallan Real Estate Inc. are reviewed for compliance with fair housing laws. We prohibit the use of language that implies a preference or limitation based on any protected characteristic. This includes descriptions of neighborhoods, schools, or community demographics that could be construed as steering.

## Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation to access our services or view a property, please contact us and we will work to meet your needs. See our full Reasonable Accommodations Policy for details.

## Reporting Discrimination

If you believe you have experienced housing discrimination, you may file a complaint with:

**U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)**
- Phone: 1-800-669-9777
- Online: www.hud.gov/fairhousing

**New York State Division of Human Rights**
- Phone: 1-888-392-3644
- Online: www.dhr.ny.gov

**New York City Commission on Human Rights**
- Phone: 311 or (212) 306-7450
- Online: www.nyc.gov/humanrights
